title: Indian-Style Roasted Turkey Neck
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that's perfect for a special occasion. This recipe yields a crispy-skinned, tender, and juicy turkey neck.
instructions: Rinse the turkey neck under cold water, pat it dry with paper towels, and season with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together curry powder, garam masala, and ginger.
Rub the spice mixture all over the turkey neck, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the turkey neck until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the turkey neck for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and add the onion and garlic to the pan. Roast for an additional 20 minutes, or until the onion is caramelized.
Remove the turkey neck from the skillet and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Strain the juices from the skillet and serve them alongside the roasted turkey neck.
